human_hints.title: Beatless vocal intro
human_hints.summary: No kick, no bass. Soft vocal over a sustained pad.

human_hints.title: Vocal verse, still no beat
human_hints.summary: Vocal at full level over pads. Bass and kick still absent.

human_hints.title: Instrumental drop groove
human_hints.summary: No vocals. Full kick/snare/hat groove with the bass line.

human_hints.title: Vocal peak
human_hints.summary: Full-level vocal lead with the whole mix up.

human_hints.title: Breakdown vocal, no beat
human_hints.summary: Vocal alone over pads. No bass, no kick.

human_hints.title: Rebuild under the vocal
human_hints.summary: The kick comes back under the vocal and grows. The bass is still out until the end.

human_hints.title: Bass return (pre-drop)
human_hints.summary: The bass comes back in before the vocal leaves.

human_hints.title: Instrumental drop 2
human_hints.summary: No vocals. Full kick/snare/hat groove with the bass line.

human_hints.title: Final vocal over the groove
human_hints.summary: Vocal returns at moderate level over the full groove.

human_hints.title: Outro fade
human_hints.summary: The beat and bass stop. The vocal tail fades over pads.
